verdict.rationale: ADK documents Callbacks that hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle to run custom side-effects, so code-defined, event-triggered actions are a first-party feature. This only covers internal agent-lifecycle events defined in code; there is no evidence of a rules engine or of triggers on external events. Missing for 10: declarative rule definition, triggers on external/business events (e.g., incoming data, schedules, system events), documented examples of rule-to-action automation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Callbacks: Hook into specific events during an agent's execution lifecycle to add logging, monitoring, or custom side-effects without altering core agent logic.
